Source-assisted selected reading of F-4usd (Paris, BnF, Latin 11411, ff. 104-105). Lines below were reread on the image by a research reader with the 1625 Giunta print and Cologny, Cod. Bodmer 58 at hand; all other lines of the four faces rest on the image-only first reading. (..) = expanded abbreviation; ? = uncertain; [..] = lost or not read. Weight signs and numerals uncertain.
